## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] The failing test came first, and the checks pass
      (`ruff format`, `ruff check`, `mypy`, `bandit`, `pytest`)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or real trace content in the change
- [ ] ADR added or updated if this changes the architecture, a dependency
      or a security property
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` updated if what is built or verified changed
